There are no network requests, no dynamic script injections, no obfuscation, no references to external or attacker-controlled domains, and no attempts to manipulate system or user data beyond event handling. Compared to the known malicious patterns, which involve dynamic script injection from suspicious or typo-squatted domains, obfuscation, or loading trojanized libraries, this code is purely a compatibility shim with no suspicious side effects.
